exploration.title: Claim Element Graph
openQuestions: Should claim elements live inside PatentClaim, or in a sibling ClaimElementTree projection keyed by claimNumber? Recommended: sibling, so the completed patent-document-schema stays stable and elements get their own epistemic candidate lifecycle.

Deterministic-first (FLAN/PHAGE rules, claim-text XML nesting, determiner antecedents) or LLM-first decomposition? Recommended: deterministic-first, with an LLM pass second, admitted only through CandidateClaim.
Which primary metric: strict structural equality under one consistent mapping, or IPRally-style teacher-agreement IoU? Recommended: strict equality, with IoU reported only for comparison.
Is NC-licensed data (PANORAMA CC BY-NC 4.0, PatClaimEval) acceptable as internal-only evaluation data, never shipped or redistributed?
Are chemical/Markush claims in scope for the first slice, or deferred? Recommended: deferred, keeping only the strict-metric lesson from MarkushGlyph.

Which consumer goes first: the drafting ledger's ClaimLimitationSupportSet, a deterministic 112(b) antecedent self-check, an OA per-element mapping record, Distinction.missing_limitation as an element reference, or KG element node kinds? Recommended: antecedent self-check, then the drafting support set.
How large a hand-labelled US claim set do we need to measure the deterministic floor, and the checker's false-positive rate on allowed claims (which no paper measures)? Where do its claims come from?
